data.title: bn-ck6v: Parquet candidate migration docs
data.description: Review exact candidate/public version claims, WIT and Lua field names, authority and bounds wording, and absence of premature installability claims.

data.reason: LGTM: exact 1a8e70c..717cb3c docs-only range is accurate. Live GitHub/release archive confirms public v0.1.0 only, with inspect/read-cell and >=0.31.0; no v0.1.1 tag or asset. Candidate manifest/component expose 0.1.1 inspect/read-cell/read-column/read-rows with fixed 16 MiB input and no imports. just check (26 tests + doctest, clippy, Wasm validation/WIT target) and sigil validate/inspect pass. The new text explicitly forbids treating 0.1.1 as installable/lock-authoritative before separate publication.
